Do you have strong location preferences? This map tracks the locations of postings on the American Economic Association's [Job Openings for Economics](https://www.aeaweb.org/joe/listings) in case you do. (I of course use the [Equal Earth map projection](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/09/1168284) to comply with the UN.)

<iframe id="joe-map-frame" src="joe-map/index.html" title="Map of economics job openings on JOE" style="width: 100%; height: 85vh; border: 0; display: block;"></iframe>

<script>
// Grow the frame to the map's full height so the map never scrolls inside its own box.
(function () {
  var frame = document.getElementById("joe-map-frame");
  frame.addEventListener("load", function () {
    var win = frame.contentWindow, body = win.document.body;
    var fit = function () { frame.style.height = body.scrollHeight + "px"; };
    fit();
    new win.ResizeObserver(fit).observe(body);
  });
})();
</script>

[Open the map in its own window](joe-map/index.html).
